⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. When ready to eat, microwave the rice with a wet paper towel first to get it steamed, then add in your meat and microwave till warm, and finally add your salad to preserve the crunch and enjoy! 📩 Save this Soy Glazed Chicken recipe to make for later! #highprotein #lowcaloriemeals #mealprep #mealplan #healthyrecipe #weightlossmeals #asianfood #chicken

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

High Protein Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice🍗🍘 57g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros: Per Serving - 6 Total) 562 Calories 56gC | 11gF | 57gP Ingredients: 1.2KG Thinly Sliced Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) 2 Tsp Cajun Seasoning 2 Tsp Olive Oil 1/2 Diced Brown Onion 500g Diced Capsicum/Bell Peppers 4 Diced Garlic Cloves 30g Light Butter (Nuttelex Light) 1/2 Tsp Cajun Seasoning 960g Cooked White Rice Creamy Cajun Sauce: 30g Light Butter (Nuttelex Light) 1/2 Tsp Cajun Seasoning 400ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy) 150g Light Cream Cheese 1/2 Tsp Chilli Powder 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 30g Grated Parmesan Cheese Steps:  1. Cook the chicken on medium - high heat for approximately 4 minutes on each side, once cooked set it aside. 3. Leave the chicken juice in the pan & cook diced brown onion, diced capsicum/bell peppers & diced garlic cloves until softened. 4. To a seperate pan on medium heat add light butter with a bit more cajun seasoning, after about 1 minute add light evaporated milk with a bit more cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, grated parmesan cheese & mix until smooth & creamy. 6. Equally distribute the chicken, rice & sauce into 6 servings, sprinkle with parsley flakes & enjoy.  #chickenrecipes #mealprep #easyrecipe #highprotein #healthyrecipes

One-pan Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta🔥483 cals 53g protein 13g fat 39g carbs Cookbook in bio 🔗 Ingredients: this makes 6 servings 2.5 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, diced 10 oz uncooked pasta (rigatoni) 1 medium yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 1/2 an orange bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp minced garlic 3 cups low-sodium chicken broth 1 block 1/3 fat cream cheese or 8 oz 50g grated Parmesan Homemade Cajun Seasoning: 2 tsp smoked paprika 2 tsp garlic powder 1½ tsp onion powder 1 tsp dried oregano 1 tsp dried thyme 1 tsp black pepper ½–1 tsp cayenne pepper 1 tsp salt Directions: 1. Mix together all of your Cajun seasoning. 2. Season the diced chicken generously with about ⅔ of the seasoning. 3. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 3–4 minutes until browned on the outside but not completely cooked through. 4. Add the onion and bell pepper and cook for another 2–3 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. 5. Add the uncooked pasta, chicken broth and remaining Cajun seasoning. Stir everything together and bring to a gentle boil. 6. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover and cook for 10–13 minutes, stirring every few minutes so the pasta doesn’t stick. 7. Cook until the pasta is al dente and most of the liquid has been absorbed. 8. Reduce the heat to low and stir in the cream cheese and Parmesan until everything comes together into a thick, creamy Cajun sauce. 9. Let it sit for 2–3 minutes to thicken, divide into 6 containers and you’ve got meal prep for the week! Follow for more #mealprep #highprotein #cajunchicken #chickenpasta #fatlossrecipes

Street Corn Chicken Bowls: Gut Healthy Edition 🌽 @Nature Made  Juicy spiced chicken, the most addictive green sauce you've ever made, and a zesty street corn salad. High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic and lime juice. Mix well & marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. For even more flavor, char the corn in a hot skillet for 5–7 with a splash of neutral oil before mixing with the remaining street corn ingredients. Refrigerate. 3. To a food processor or blender, add all of the Aji Verde ingredients and blend until smooth & vibrant green. 4. I recommend making rice for the bowls! 2 cups of long grain white rice should do the trick. Once done, fluff with 2 tbsp olive oil, ¼ cup fresh cilantro and a splash of lime juice. 5. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat & add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden & cooked through. Set aside. 6. Assemble your bowls with the rice, chicken, street corn salad, a generous drizzle of aji verde, extra cotija, and fresh cilantro. Enjoy :)

EASY & DELICIOUS PROTEIN PREP 🔥 Episode 7️⃣    I’ve just discovered the best way to meal prep chicken for the week. Don’t forget to follow me for the next episodes in this series - I’ve got plenty more to come.  Take your chicken, marinate in incredible flavours and roast it in the oven and you are left with the juiciest and most delicious chicken for the week.  7: BANGING CHICKEN CASSEROLE Calories & macros (when divided into 5) 📊 244 calories 39g P | 9g C | 6g F This is week 7 of this new recipe series and all you need to do is:  1. Add 900g boneless, skinless chicken thighs to a large bowl or tub. You can trim off the excess fat if you want but I left it . 2. Take a tin of chopped tomatoes & add it to the chicken.  3. Add the packet of chicken casserole seasoning (I got mine from Lidl)  4. Add 3-4 pinches salt, black pepper, paprika and 15g garlic puree.   5. Mix really well and marinate for 2-6 hrs, but even better overnight. You can also make it right away if you like. The longer you leave it, the better the flavour!  6. When you're ready to eat, preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius 375F. Remove chicken from the fridge and let it come up to room temp (about 30 mins) before placing in the oven. 7. Pack the marinated chicken tightly into a loaf pan (my measurements were 8.5x4.5x2.5). Place in the oven for 50 mins. 8. Remove the chicken from the oven, gently tilt the pan into a glass jar to remove the excess juices. Pour the juices over the chicken, then repeat. Set juices aside and use for soups or you can cook rice in it for ultimate flavour. Or add to a few tbsps of light mayo to make a sauce like I did.  9. Flip loaf pan onto a cutting board and cut chicken thin slices or strips. I portioned mine into 5 but you can also make it into 6.  Serve however you want & don’t forget to follow!

CHIPOTLE HONEY CHICKEN BOWLS CHICKEN 3 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo* ¼ cup honey + more to drizzle ¼ cup olive oil + juice of 2 limes 1 Tbsp EACH garlic powder, onion powder + paprika 2 tsp EACH chili powder, cumin + oregano 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1 tsp black pepper Add everything to chicken, toss well + marinate. Spread on a sheet pan, drizzle with a little more honey + bake at 425°F for 20–25 min or until 165°F. Broil briefly at the end if you want more char. *Spicy: use the whole can, peppers + sauce. Mild: use the adobo sauce but leave out the peppers. CILANTRO-LIME RICE 3 cups long-grain rice + ¾–1 cup warm chicken broth + ½ cup cilantro + juice of 2 limes + 2 Tbsp olive oil + salt. Cook rice; while HOT, add cilantro, lime, oil + salt, then slowly add broth while fluffing until absorbed. CORN SALSA 3 cups corn (canned or frozen) + 1 diced jalapeño + ½ diced red onion + ½ bunch chopped cilantro + juice 1–2 limes + S&P. Mix. BLACK BEANS 2 cans black beans + 1 tsp cumin + salt + splash chicken broth. Warm together. PICO 4 tomatoes + ½ red onion + ½ bunch cilantro, all diced + juice 1–2 limes + salt. Mix. SHEET-PAN BEEF KEBABS 3 lb ground beef 1 large white onion + 1 red bell pepper 6 garlic cloves + 1 bunch parsley 2 Tbsp paprika + 1 Tbsp cumin 2 tsp EACH coriander + turmeric 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp cinnamon (optional) Food-process onion, pepper, garlic + parsley until finely chopped. Transfer to cheesecloth + squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Add to beef with all spices + hand mix. Press evenly onto a sheet pan. Use a bench scraper to make deep kebab-style rows as shown in the video. Bake at 425°F for ~15 min, carefully drain excess liquid/fat, then broil 3–5 min until browned. ROASTED PEPPERS + ONIONS 2 red + 2 yellow bell peppers + 2 red onions + 1 bunch scallions + 2 tsp EACH paprika + cumin + olive oil + S&P. Rub all over, place CUT-SIDE DOWN + roast at 425°F until tender + deeply caramelized. BROCCOLI Broccoli florets + olive oil + garlic powder + S&P.
